title: Help me with my game please
author: Difficult-Future-324
selftext: I know a lot of people will say my game is AI slop but I have seen a lot of stuff on social media with people having AI make games for them. It’s always been kind of a dream of mine to be able to make games, and although I don’t expect this to blow up I have enjoyed playing it myself with some friends. I would appreciate if some of you could test it out and let me know what to add/change. I want to get to the 250 highly engaged player mark though I know it’s unlikely. I did put an insane amount of time into it even if it is 75% AI, all feedback is welcome!

comments.author: kytheon
comments.body:
AI plus Roblox slop. The name is as generic as it gets.

"I have seen a lot of stuff on social media"

Look, I support your dream of making games. But this is like all the marketing guys I ever see who barge into the games industry to make money with slop.

comments.author: gpubattle
comments.body: I'd recommend making the game with AI on three.js so you can just host the game on a website for 5 bucks a month using SiteGround. You will build something way more long term. Roblox gaming is dying....

replies.author: ThisIsKappa
replies.body: Games that run 14million simultanious players. Roblox is not dying.

replies.author: gpubattle
replies.body: AI game devs will eat more of the pie up overtime outside of their platform.

replies.author: ThisIsKappa
replies.body: There's plenty if pie. Its not starving nor dying. Its not even showing any hungry signs.
